help.description: Use commands by Tagging the bot or using `/` prefix (e.g. `@Zeryn play ...` or `/play ...`)
help.guide_value:
Select a category from the dropdown menu below to see command details.

**Automated & Advanced Features:**
🎉 **Welcome & Goodbye:** Greeting messages, background cards & embeds.
🪪 **Auto Roles:** Automatically assign roles to new members/bots.
⭐ **Leveling & XP:** Gain XP, rank up and unlock reward roles.
🎵 **Music:** High quality YouTube, Lofi, Playlist, Autoplay music.
🎫 **Tickets:** Support ticket system with intuitive interactive menu.
✨ **Reaction Roles:** Assign roles by reacting to messages.
🛡️ **Automods:** Anti-spam, dangerous link, and word filter.
📝 **Logging:** Log message updates/deletions, role & channel edits...
🎁 **Giveaways:** Automatic giveaways and winner rolling events.

privacy.subtitle: Our commitment to transparency in collecting, storing, and protecting user and Discord server data.
privacy.summary_item1: We collect minimal essential data required for bot operations (Server IDs, Channel IDs, Settings).
privacy.summary_item2: We NEVER sell, share, or monetize your data to any third party.
privacy.summary_item3: You have the right to request full data deletion for your user profile or server at any time.
privacy.s2_bullet1: Server Data: Server ID, Server Name, Channel IDs, Role IDs, and custom configurations (Welcome, AutoMod, Ticket, Leveling).
privacy.s2_bullet2: User Data: User ID, Username, Avatar URL, XP/Level statistics, AutoMod warning counts, and personal music playlists.
privacy.s2_bullet3: Audit Logs: Temporary message edit/delete logs (ONLY collected if the server admin enables the Logger module).
privacy.s2_note: ❌ WE DO NOT COLLECT: Private direct message (DM) content, personal passwords, payment information, or real-world identities.
privacy.s3_bullet1: Maintaining and storing server feature configurations.
privacy.s3_bullet2: Authenticating Web Dashboard sessions securely via Discord OAuth2.
privacy.s3_bullet3: Calculating XP levels, generating Rank Cards, and assigning reward roles automatically.
privacy.s3_bullet4: Enforcing server moderation tools (AutoMod, Warnings, Support Tickets).
privacy.s4_desc: Data is securely stored in a WAL-mode SQLite database on isolated infrastructure. Redis cache handles short-lived data securely. Strict access controls ensure raw database access is restricted exclusively to core bot systems.
privacy.s5_title: 5. User Rights & Data Deletion (Right to be Forgotten)
privacy.s5_desc: You have the right to inspect or delete data associated with your user account or server:
privacy.s5_bullet1: Server Data Deletion: Server owners may request complete database purging upon removing the bot from their server.
privacy.s5_bullet2: User Data Deletion: Users can request XP/Level resets or personal data deletion via our Discord Support Server Ticket Channel.
privacy.s6_desc: We PROUDLY GUARANTEE: We NEVER sell, rent, or trade user data to third parties or advertising networks. Data transfers occur strictly via encrypted HTTPS/WSS connections with official Discord APIs.
privacy.s7_desc: Zeryn Bot complies with Discord's age requirements (13+ or local legal minimum age). We do not knowingly collect data from children under legal age limits.
privacy.s8_desc: This policy may be updated periodically to reflect feature enhancements or legal requirements. Revision dates are publicly displayed. For privacy inquiries, please contact our team on the official Discord Support Server.
